title: Red Planet Trio
description: A surreal black alien with three eyes holds a crystal ball containing multiple faces, standing beside large red and orange poppies on a red triangular patterned planet against a starry purple and black cosmic background. A small human figure with a backpack walks across the planet's surface near the alien's feet.
